messages:
morgan: Postmortem follow-up. Pattern: broad flag ramps without tight canary gates -> repeat blast radius. Proposal: a lightweight 'rollout leash' (pre-ramp probe + metadata + safe-auto-rollback). Need owners and quick tickets.

morgan: Rollout leash pieces:
- pre-ramp micro-probe (default 1% for 5m)
- flag contract (rollback_safe, owner, max_pct, scope)
- allowlist for auto-rollback only for rollback_safe=true
- audit events for every automated action

zuri: I can own rollout leash (auto-rollback + audit). Draft rule: rollback when 5xx delta >2pp for 5m OR p95 >1.8x baseline for 5m. Limit auto attempts to 2 per 24h per-flag. ETA: 9d.

zuri: sample rule (short):
```yaml
rollback:
  enabled_if: rollback_safe
  triggers:
    - metric: five_xx_delta_pp > 2.0 for 5m
    - metric: p95_multiplier > 1.8 for 5m
  max_auto_attempts_per_24h: 2
```

kai: I'll take the flag contract + naming conv. Suggest name pattern svc.area.feature.env and add max_pct default 5 for prod. Will add owner contact field. ETA: 5d.

leo: I'll wire the pre-ramp probe into CI and Console. Probe default: 1% x 5m, compare to rolling 30m baseline; low-signal fallback uses 24h EWMA. Fail -> hold + page. ETA: 7d.

morgan: Good. Ensure audit events include {flag, scope, trigger, baseline_snapshot, action}. That will help postmortem trends.

zuri: will log events to infra.audit and include incident link when available. Also add a pre-rollback notify to owner Slack + email; rollback proceeds after 60s if no human cancel.
